args: Grasp phase: approach. Confirm the same physical package. Request table_check on an unobstructed part of the saved tabletop polygon, using a different view/interior pixel if needed. For approach, inspect the elevated straight open-hand sweep to hover including yaw. For descent, inspect the vertical open-hand corridor and package stationarity. For close, require both package sides visibly straddled by open fingers, not a grasp yet. For lift1, closure has been delivered: straddled_closed may still be table-supported and is sufficient for ONE observation-producing 25 mm upward test if that corridor is clear. Do NOT require retention or lifted clearance before this test. For lift2 and verify, require actual held_clear evidence, not just closure or command delivery; lift2 also needs its next 25 mm upward corridor clear. Unknown/occluded clearance is not clear. No bowl transport or release is requested.

geometry.tracker_identity: Inset textured top face of this cream-cheese package; original frame 0.

result.explanation: The labeled cream-cheese package matches the saved frame-0 outline and remains on the tabletop; no execution intervened. The elevated straight open-hand sweep to the specified hover, including the small orientation change, is visibly clear of external objects. The bottle, bowl and cooktop are below or outside that sweep. Robot geometry at the starting pose is self-occlusion, not an external obstacle. table_check selects exposed tabletop inside the saved polygon, between the package and bowl.

parameters.detail: Clearance assessment applies only to the elevated approach to hover, not descent, closure, lift or transport. The open fingers are not yet straddling the package. top_check is on the same labeled top face; table_check avoids the bowl rim and package.
